product_metadata.title: SGHUO 4 Pack Comforter Organizer Storage Clothes Storage, Storage for Blankets, 90L Foldable Clothes Storage Bag with Clear Window, Sturdy Zipper and Reinforced Handle for Comforters, Pillow
features: UPGRADE MATERIAL: The organizer is made from high-quality, odorless 150gsm non-woven fabric which promotes ventilation and protects your stored articles from moisture and dust.

LARGE CAPACITY: The comforter storage bag comes in a set of 4, and each bag measures 60 x 40 x 35cm / 23.6x 15.7 x13.8 in. It is spacious for your comforters, blankets, pillows, quilts, linen or other clothing.
PREMIUM QUALITY: 100% brand new, Our storage bags are specially made with the highest quality non-woven fabric to ensure more durability and a sturdy form.
CLEAR WINDOW DESIGN & TWO-WAY ZIPPERS: See-through window in the front for quick viewing what are stored inside the container. 2 Strong zippers closure, Keeps your stuff dust-free.

VERSATILITY: The storage bags set can be used for closet or under the bed. It is suitable for dormitory, attic, basement and bedroom use. Also, the foldable design allows it to be easily stored when not in use.
description: 1. Package includes: 4 non-woven storage bags, black. 2. Material: The storage bag is made of polypropylene non-woven fabric, which is dust-proof and moisture-proof. You don't have to worry about your quilt or clothes being moldy. 3. Each storage bag size: 23.6''L X 15.7'' W X 13.8''H. It is spacious and suitable for storing bedding, blankets, pillows, plush toys, seasonal clothing, holiday decorations, etc. 4. Transparent window design and two-way zipper: The perspective window provides quick access to internally stored items. The two-way zipper makes it easy to slide along the cover when in use, no matter how full the bag is. 5. Heavy duty handle: The storage bag has two side handles for easy transport from one place to another. A reinforced seam is implemented to increase strength and the handle can withstand a load of approximately 11 pounds. 6. The storage bag set can be placed under the wardrobe or under the bed. Suitable for dorms, wardrobes, lofts, basements and bedrooms. 7.The foldable design allows it to be folded under the bed or in a drawer when not in use.
